description: Agent IP Records: submit docket records with the matters and filings they answer to across the portfolio: the moment the docket is read at; each matter with its id, reference, the application or registration number it carries, its title and whether the matter record holds it open or closed; each docket entry with its id, reference, the matter, the number it is recorded against, its kind (deadline or closing), what is due and the moment it is due; each filing or response with its id, reference, the matter, the docket entry it answers and the moment filed. The signed report gives the docket and the matters, each docketed deadline against a filing or response recorded against it, each docket entry’s number against the number its matter carries, and each matter the docket shows closed against the matter record, and counts them, and names divergent docket records: a deadline the docket states with no matching filing or response recorded, a docket entry recorded against the wrong application or registration number, and a matter the docket shows closed that other records still treat as open; then a docket entry naming a matter the records do not hold and a filing recorded after the deadline it answers, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No docket entries, a deadline with no due date, or an unanswered deadline with no reading moment leaves those points unverified. Docket entries, matters and filings match by letters and digits, a filing to the docket entry it answers by the entry reference, a deadline reads as met by any filing recorded against it and as unmet once the reading moment passes its due date with none, dates compare by the day, and a matter reads as closed on the docket by a closing entry. This reads the calendar and the cross-references across the whole portfolio: wever_ip-prosecution-check reads the substance of office actions and responses on one matter, while the docket check reads every deadline, number and closing on the docket against the matters and filings on record. Verdict ip_docket_divergent, ip_docket_partial, ip_docket_unverified or ip_docket_consistent. POST /api/ip-docket-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.

as_of.description: The moment the docket is read at, such as 2026-03-02.

action.description: What is due, such as an office action response.

due_at.description: When it is due, such as 2026-03-02.

number.description: The application or registration the entry is recorded against number.

entry.description: The docket entry it answers reference.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

matters.description: Each matter as the portfolio and office records hold it.
